items.quote: And Moses and Aaron came in unto Pharaoh, and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD God of the Hebrews, How long wilt thou refuse to humble thyself before me? let my people go, that they may serve me.
items.claim: Moses and Aaron delivered a message to Pharaoh from the LORD God of the Hebrews demanding he release the Hebrew people to serve God
items.actor: Moses, Aaron, Pharaoh (recipient), LORD God of the Hebrews (claimed speaker)
items.action: came in unto Pharaoh, and said unto him
